title: Fire at HPCL's Visakhapatnam refinery near an oil tank; no injuries reported
body: A fire broke out on Monday evening at HPCL's Visakh Refinery, near a tank holding Ruf Pitch Oil, per Times of India. HPCL sources reported no injuries or casualties; the cause is unclear and officials considered an explosion unlikely. Hindustan Times carried it as an explosion report.

steps.e: Fire near an oil tank at the Visakh Refinery
Cause unclear; explosion rumours played down
